title: Latvia joins diplomatic ballistic missile pledge
summary_full: On 11th August, Latvia and several other countries joined a joint statement initiated by the United States of America (USA) on ballistic missile launch notifications, in which countries are encouraged to participate in mechanisms such as the Hague Code of Conduct against Ballistic Missile Proliferation, which provides for advance notification of ballistic missile launches.
